author: Eteh
body:
Hi,

so I've been looking at the weekly leaderboards and thought of a suggestion to make it more competitive / rewarding for the top 3 people in the weekly leaderboards.

Let's say Player9173 is first, Player2837 is second and Player1110 is third in the weekly leaderboard (for any gamemode), the prizes would be 3,000, 2,000 and 1,000 credits. 

What's your opinion and suggestion about this? Any recommendations on what the prize should be?

replies.author: Petlas
replies.body: Eh, it has its pros and cons, really. Like mentioned, the boards are usually buggy, so prizes could be easily dealt unfairly. Plus, certain players might become aware of loopholes in the bugginess and somehow find a way to exploit their way to the top.
